frontier_selector.why: The presence of multiple semisessile, nonbleeding 1–5 mm polyps in the rectum and sigmoid colon with surrounding erythematous, eroded mucosa and histiocytes containing numerous basophilic spherical and targetoid inclusions that were strongly positive on von Kossa and periodic acid–Schiff stains decided it.

two to three loose bowel movements per day (Bristol type 5–6) with mixed blood
